title: Query 1: Single Image Captioning & Major Objects
description: Dense land-cover scene description and major structural object inventory on high-resolution optical imagery.
example_query: Describe the land-cover and major objects visible in this image.
expected_answer_summary: Identifies agricultural cropland (48.2%), residential buildings (38 structures), and water canal.

title: Query 2: Text-Guided Region Grounding
description: Ground and segment the specific water body referred to in natural language prompt.
example_query: Highlight the water body referred to in the query.
expected_answer_summary: Grounds 14.85 ha reservoir with sub-pixel edge alignment and vector polygon mask.

title: Query 3: Multi-Temporal Change & Spatial Mapping
description: 12-stage sequential change detection isolating where and how much surface change occurred.
example_query: What changed between these two dates, and where did the change occur?
expected_answer_summary: Detects 13.78 ha flood inundation in river basin with 18.2% pseudo-change suppressed.

title: Query 4: Cross-Modal Optical + SAR Joint Extraction
description: Combines co-registered Optical multispectral with SAR C-band radar backscatter.
example_query: Use the optical and SAR images together to identify built-up and water-covered regions.
expected_answer_summary: Identifies 18.4% water (SAR specular) and 23.6% built-up (SAR double bounce) through clouds.
talking_points: Directly utilizes ISRO RISAT C-band physics

title: Query 5: Bi-Temporal Change-VQA (CDVQA)
description: Reasoning over temporal pairs to evaluate directional change of built-up infrastructure.
example_query: Has the built-up area increased, decreased, or remained unchanged?
expected_answer_summary: Categorical answer: INCREASED (+3.45 ha, +14.2% expansion in northern corridor).
talking_points: Directional categorical answer with quantitative proof

title: Assam / Kerala Flood Inundation (Cartosat-2S)
description: Detect and quantify flood inundation from extreme monsoon event over river basin.
example_query: How much area has been flooded between these two dates?
expected_answer_summary: Approximately 11.93 hectares of surface water expansion detected, HIGH confidence (0.97).
talking_points: Rapid disaster assessment for relief teams
GeoJSON boundary export ready for Bhuvan/VEDAS GIS teams

title: Forest Canopy Loss & Road Encroachment
description: Detect selective clearing and logging road expansion in protected evergreen corridor.
example_query: Has this forest area shrunk since last season?
expected_answer_summary: Detected 4.2 hectares of canopy loss with linear encroachment pattern, HIGH confidence (0.94).
talking_points: STSF-Net pseudo-change filter suppresses seasonal leaf color variation

title: Urban Expansion & Built-Up Encroachment
description: Identify new construction on agricultural parcels along peri-urban periphery.
example_query: Identify new construction and urban growth in this sector.
expected_answer_summary: Detected 2.8 hectares of new impervious surface / structural growth, HIGH confidence (0.91).
